subject.title: Require Codex scan artifact coverage proof

question: Should ClawHub require `artifact_coverage` proof before any benign Codex worker result can be stored as clean, once the zero-byte verifier bug and branch conflicts are repaired?
rationale: This changes the authoritative scan trust boundary and can fail closed for existing worker/model outputs, so automation cannot safely choose the rollout contract by itself.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Adopt the stricter worker contract after fixing zero-byte coverage, adding regression coverage, and refreshing the branch against current main.

options.title: Stage compatibility mode
options.body: Keep current behavior as the default while adding an operator-controlled or shadow validation path before enforcing the new output contract.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave the PR draft or close it in favor of a narrower contract-design item if maintainers are not ready to enforce fail-closed coverage proof.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Adopt the stricter worker contract after fixing zero-byte coverage, adding regression coverage, and refreshing the branch against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work owns the worker and diagnostics surface that this stricter contract must integrate with.
